card.name: Unusual and at risk in overdose text
card.fires_on: The word "unusual" in the stock overdosage sentence "interaction among drugs, and unusual drug kinetics". Also "risk" in "particularly at risk" about premature neonates and aluminum.

modes.label: Unusual drug kinetics
modes.description: The word "unusual" ending the list of overdose considerations, just before "drug kinetics".
modes.example: In managing overdosage, consider the possibility of multiple drug overdoses, interaction among drugs, and<< unusual>> drug kinetics in your patient.

modes.description: The word "risk" after "particularly at" in warnings about premature infants and aluminum.
